description:
Query SEC filings by form type, date range, CIK and/or 8-K item.

Returns filings newest first. Each filing's content_object lists its documents
(sequence 1 is the primary); read one with get_document(cik, accession_number,
filename). Cite beatandraise_base_url + filename; the filing's source has a
ready-made citation. 8-Ks carry their items ("2.02 Results of Operations...").
R*.htm files are XBRL table pages (list_filing_tables names them).

An 8-K carries a headline when its press release has one: found by rules, so use
it to choose which 8-K to read, not as a quotation (verify_quote first). No
headline says nothing about the filing. An 8-K with only Item 9.01 and no headline
files exhibits only (exhibits_only lists them) and is rarely news.

Args:
    form: SEC form type (e.g. "10-K", "10-Q", "8-K", "4", "13F-HR", "S-1"), or
        several comma-separated in one call (up to 20), e.g.
        "N-CSR,N-CSRS,N-CSR/A,N-CSRS/A" or "10-K,10-K/A". Amendments are
        their own form types, so name them to include them.
    cik: Company CIK (e.g. "0000320193" or "320193")
    from_date: Start date inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Without cik, defaults to
        30 days before to_date (or today); pass it to reach older filings.
    to_date: End date inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD)
    limit: Max results (1-100, default 100; at most 25 with include_item_text).
        For more, page with offset
    offset: Pagination offset
    item: Only 8-Ks reporting this item, by its number as the 8-K header states it,
        e.g. "5.02" (departure or election of directors or officers, officers' pay),
        "1.01" (material agreement), "2.01" (acquisition or disposal), "4.01"
        (auditor change), "5.07" (shareholder vote); several comma-separated match
        any ("1.01,2.01"). Defaults form to "8-K,8-K/A". Numbered since 2004-08-23.
        Use it instead of reading 8-Ks one by one.
    include_item_text: With item, also return each filing's text of that item
        (item_texts, with a highlight_url), so a screen across companies is one call:
        whether a 5.02 is a director, a CEO or a pay plan is in the text.
    item_text: Items whose text to return with each 10-K, 10-Q or 8-K, by number or
        name, up to 5 comma-separated ("MD&A", "1A", "Risk Factors", "5.02"). With
        form="10-Q" and a cik, "MD&A" gives the last several MD&As in one call.
    item_text_chars: Characters per Item, 1,000-100,000 (default 10,000); a page
        carries at most 500,000, so limit is lowered to fit.
name: get_filings
title: List Filings
